assays.assay_name: Drug Discrimination (2-lever LSD vs saline, food-reinforced)
assays.assay_description: Rats trained in 2-lever operant chambers (grid floor, food pellet dispenser, MedPC V) to discriminate 0.1 mg/kg LSD i.p. from saline under FR10-TO20" food reinforcement (30-min training sessions or 30 reinforcers). Substitution tests with LSD, 1A-LSD, 1P-LSD, 1B-LSD, 1CP-LSD and LSZ given 15 min (or 30 min for 1P-LSD) before test; tests ended after a single unreinforced FR10. Measures: % drug-appropriate responding and response rate.

application_type.evidence: All drug solutions were injected intraperitoneally (IP) at a constant volume of 1.0 mL/kg body weight.

setup_habituation.evidence: not reported (extensive response shaping/training in chambers, but no separate no-data habituation described)

setup_restrain.evidence: All training and testing sessions were conducted in operant conditioning chambers equipped with 2 response levers; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: subjects were food-restricted... for the duration of the drug discrimination experiment... Body weights were maintained at ~85% of their previously established free-feeding weight

water_restriction.evidence: No water source described in the operant chamber; chambers equipped with levers, stimuli and food pellet dispenser only.

time_to_assay.evidence: A single dose of a test substance, or saline, was administered 15 minutes before sessions... option of performing substitution tests 30 minutes after an injection

sample_size.evidence: Twelve rats were trained in the drug discrimination experiment, but data from only 8 of the rats were used unless...; Fig. 5: 'n = 6-10 rats'; Table 6: 1P-LSD (30 min) sessions 'involved 4 rats not included in the other substitution test series'

outcomes.summary: All lysergamides fully substituted for the 0.1 mg/kg LSD training stimulus. 1CP-LSD was equipotent to LSD, LSZ nominally most potent, 1A-LSD ~100-fold less potent; 1P-LSD required a 30-min pretreatment to produce full substitution. Some doses of 1P-LSD, 1B-LSD and 1A-LSD reduced response rates.
outcomes.statistics: Slopes: F(5, 31) = 3.32, P < .05 (Dunnett LSD vs LSZ P < .05); ED50: F(5, 38) = 54.77, P < .05; response rate: 1P-LSD F(5, 35) = 16.04, adjusted P = .0006; 1B-LSD F(3, 21) = 5.437, adjusted P = .025; 1A-LSD F(3, 21) = 8.013, adjusted P = .005; Hedge g > 0.8 for significant potency differences
outcomes.evidence: All test compounds except 1P-LSD dose-dependently produced full substitution for 0.1 mg/kg LSD 15 minutes following administration. However, when tested 30 minutes following administration, 1P-LSD became more potent and more effective, producing full substitution for 0.1 mg/kg LSD at a dose of 1.0 mg/kg.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The percentage of drug-appropriate responding was calculated... The rate of responding was calculated by dividing the total number of responses by the session time

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data are session totals (percent drug-appropriate responding, overall response rate); no within-session time course.

B4_ethological.evidence: Operant lever pressing for food; no natural-repertoire behaviours scored.

B5_social.evidence: Rats tested individually in operant chambers; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: trained male Sprague-Dawley rats to discriminate 0.1 mg/kg LSD from saline using a food-reinforced, 2-lever drug discrimination procedure

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All data collection and programming of behavioral contingencies were accomplished using MedPC V software (Med Associates Inc).

E1_environment_type.evidence: operant conditioning chambers equipped with 2 response levers, auditory and visual feedback stimuli, and a food pellet dispenser

E2_shelter.evidence: No refuge in operant chamber described.

E3_bedding.evidence: Two response levers were mounted... 4.0 cm above the grid floor

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the operant chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described; levers/lights/dispenser are apparatus components.

E7_social_context.evidence: Subjects were placed in the chambers individually.

E8_food_water.evidence: An aperture for the delivery of food pellets (45 mg grain-based food pellets; Bio-Serv)... food reinforcement was delivered upon completion of the cumulative response requirement

D1_continuity.evidence: Daily training was performed during sessions lasting 30 minutes... Test sessions were identical to the DD training sessions

D2_session_duration.evidence: Daily training was performed during sessions lasting 30 minutes or until 30 reinforcers were earned, whichever came first.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Saline test sessions were conducted between dose-effect determinations of each lysergamide; multi-dose curves for 6 compounds plus 3 saline and 3 training-dose tests (Fig. 5) on separate test days, plus daily training

D4_baseline.evidence: Saline test sessions were conducted... to obtain baseline response rates against which to compare the effects of test substances.

D5_followup.evidence: Substitution tests conducted 15 or 30 min after injection; no outcome recorded ≥24 h post-drug.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (LSD drug discrimination). Blood sampling/LC-MS/MS pharmacokinetics and in vitro binding/functional assays excluded as non-behavioural.
B1 set to 1 (2-3 measures: % drug-appropriate responding, response rate); gemma's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' category.

D3 scored 15+ (following qwen): multiple doses of six compounds plus repeated saline and training-dose test sessions on separate days clearly exceed 15 test days; deepseek's 0/not_reported and gemma's 8-14 underestimate.
D4 scored 1 (modal); paper explicitly states saline test sessions provided baseline response rates. Deepseek's 0 contradicted its own evidence.
food_restriction = 'before' (modal) given explicit ~85% body weight restriction; water_restriction = 'during' (modal).
E8 kept at 1 (unanimous): food pellets delivered during training sessions, although substitution test sessions themselves ended without reinforcement — confidence medium.
n_total = 12 because 1P-LSD 30-min tests included 4 rats outside the core group of 8; n_per_group_min = 6 from Fig. 5 legend.
LSD dosing schedule set to chronic (repeated training doses over many sessions); test compounds given as single acute doses per test session. Dose lists limited to values explicitly stated in text.
